$comment: Documented, expiring exceptions to the npm audit gate.
An entry here is a decision someone made and signed, not a suppression.
Every entry must state why it does not apply to this product and when it is
revisited. An expired entry fails the build exactly like an unknown advisory,
so an exception cannot quietly become permanent.

allow.title: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
why: The vulnerability is in React Router's RSC (React Server Components) mode and
its server-action request handling. Aria's front end is a client-only SPA:
it uses BrowserRouter with no loaders, no actions, no server rendering and no
RSC. The vulnerable code path is not reachable.
No fixed version exists yet — the advisory range is >=7.12.0 <8.3.0 and 8.3.0
is unpublished. Downgrading to 7.11.0 would clear this advisory while
reintroducing thirteen others, including an RCE via vendored turbo-stream.
Staying on 7.18.1 is strictly the safer position.
allow.revisit: Upgrade to react-router-dom >=8.3.0 as soon as it ships.
